sources.title: CLAP HTSAT-Fused: Zero-Shot Audio Classification & Retrieval Model
sources.snippet: CLAP HTSAT-Fused is a contrastive language-audio pretraining model for zero-shot audio classification, retrieval, and feature extraction. Uses HTSAT audio encoder and RoBERTa text encoder. Apache-2.0 license.

sources.title: clap-htsat-fused by laion | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: CLAP learns aligned audio and text representations through contrastive learning, similar to how CLIP works for images and text. The HTSAT-fused variant uses the HTS-AT audio transformer fused with RoBERTa text embeddings.
